highest_recall_gain_changes: Extract graphic sheet number, title and discipline code from the title block for schematic sheets, not only architectural PLAN/SECTION/FACADE identities.
Resolve graphic-sheet order through the contents/change register before page-level retrieval; keep physical page and graphic sheet number as separate fields.
Index corpus/section/zone/floor as first-class normalized signals rather than leaving them in generic rare text.
Canonicalize system roles and aliases, including old combined В1 versus new В1.1/В1.2 plus В2.1/В2.2.
Canonicalize equipment purpose separately from vendor/model so ALPHA→Wilo replacements retain pump-role continuity.
Add source→equipment→header→receiver topology tokens and explicit cross-sheet references such as «далее см. лист 1».
Retrieve a bounded union of stamp/contents, function, zone and topology channels instead of a single weighted top-K list.
Compose non-contiguous RIGHT_PAGE_GROUP candidates from function-component coverage; do not require adjacent physical pages.
Run global assignment over function/group candidates and allow a RIGHT page to cover multiple compatible left components where evidence supports it.
Audit saved page links for page-kind mismatch and surface an authority-versus-function conflict without silently overriding either.
